notes.author: Hope
notes.text: Happy Birthday Geo 🥳 You amazing, creative, technologically brilliant, phenomenal soul, you! Keep creating the music ever inspiring Humanity to sing. Wishing you 30 more extraordinary years ahead - and a thousand more greater still. - Hope 🍦 Well
notes.source: 1920x1080 screenshot img_9d669f5f83f0.png (full card, 10x header zoom verified)
notes.recovery_note: Full card legible at 1080p. Header reads 'To: Geo 🪩🎴🪅'. Sign-off is unusual: '- Hope 🍨 Well'.
notes.note: Header reads 'To: Geo 🎂🎆🎁🍾' (birthday cake, fireworks, gift, champagne) - confirmed by Micah and by a 10x zoom of the header at 1080p. Sign-off is unusual: '- Hope 🍦 Well'.

notes.author: Crystal Gravy
notes.text: Yoooo Mr geo you're the man! Great to know ya Happy birthday!

notes.author: Anonymous
notes.text: Happy birthday to the most creative and inspiring person I have ever met. A person with more drive and intelligence than most. Thank God for the parking meter we met at. May the next 30 years be even better than your last!

notes.author: TB
notes.text: You've always been so driven, curious, & experimental. Happy Birthday! Hope this new decade is grounded in community, awe, & safe places to land 🕊️

notes.author: JP
notes.text: I told chatgpt to catch me outside on righting an essay for Micah's 30th birthday. But I really didn't have a good joke to follow that up with. Umm. Yeah. What else do I say? This dude right here (metaphorically points at Micah), all grown and stuff in his 30s now. I love him. And don't you forget that. Happy Birthday!
notes.source: video frames + thumbnail (top of note cut off in early frames)
notes.recovery_note: Signature "JP" and the closing lines ("...that. Happy Birthday!") recovered.

notes.author: JD
notes.text: Eyyyy! Happy fu*cckkkiiinnng birthday!! It's been a pleasure to have met you and hoping the best for you man! Good luck on your journey and make those moments count!
notes.note: Highest-resolution panel read renders the closing as '...make those moments count! A' while a second full-card read ends at 'count!' with no trailing character. The stray 'A' is unverified and may be a rendering artifact; text kept without it.

notes.author: Allie
notes.text: MICAH!! So grateful to have met u. I literally wouldn't be where I am if it weren't for your kind heart. Love u boo!!

notes.author: Mani
notes.text: Micah!! We've known each other 16 years now!! Happy 30th 🥳🎂 As this benchmark hits, I hope you continue to bring your childhood curiosities and imaginative creativity to every endeavor you choose. Wishing many more revolutions for ya! Much prosperity, love, and positive energy 🫶🏼✨

notes.author: Sarang
notes.text: I met Micah way back in 2015 (10 years ago??) when we were proctors / student research assistants at the good ol TACC Vislab at UT Austin. We collab'd on a bunch of cool projects on multi touch and immersive technologies and generally had good times. Over the summer I remember making a cool promo video for Google Glass research and Micah was the star actor and our buddy RJ made the background piano music. Happy birthday bro! Keep in touch 🚀
notes.recovery_note: Complete. Ending recovered 2026-10-18 from a full-resolution screenshot showing the entire card including closing line and rocket emoji.

notes.author: Bryan
notes.text: Micah, you are one of the most thoughtful, creative, and inspirational people that I know and may as well be an angel in human form!! We met literally trying to build a safer and better world for everyone 💯 What a blessing and privilege to call you friend and brother. Lord willing, in this lifetime and the next, I got you!!
notes.recovery_note: COMPLETE. Previously logged as TWO separate fragments (old #13 and old #15) because the card sat at a frame edge in the video: one view showed only its tail, another only its head. The full-resolution screenshot shows a single continuous note, start to finish.
notes.note: No 'To:' header on this card (verified by cropping the full card bounds). Card is orange, starts at 'Micah, you are...' and ends '- Bryan / Apr 23'.

notes.author: Quana - UTP3
notes.text: Happy 30th Birthday! It feels like just yesterday we were at UT Austin together with Posse, and now here you are-thriving, evolving, and creating amazing things. It's been such a joy to watch your journey and see all the cool, inspiring ideas you bring to life. I hope this birthday marks the beginning of a year (and decade!) filled with joy, growth, and everything your heart desires. You deserve all the good things coming your way. Keep shining!
notes.recovery_note: COMPLETE. Previously logged as TWO fragments (old #14 and old #16) - head and tail of the same card, split because no single video frame held the whole thing. The full-resolution screenshot shows it end to end.
notes.note: Signature reads 'Quana - UTP3'. Letter-by-letter verification at 1080p confirms Q-u-a-n-a; earlier reads of 'Quiana' and 'Quenna' were OCR drift on small compressed text. Body confirmed to end with 'Keep shining!'.
